stickDesc:
Rough, bumpy skin on your legs or arms? Swipe on. Leave on. Feel the difference.

The Smooth Stick is a no-mess glycolic acid body exfoliant in a twist-up stick. It gently loosens the dead skin that makes skin look dotted and feel rough, so legs, arms and the back of the neck look and feel visibly smoother.

Why you'll like it

  • Visibly smoother, softer skin with regular use
  • Helps the look of “strawberry legs” and rough, bumpy patches
  • No scrubbing, no sticky hands, no mess: swipe and go
  • Travel-friendly solid stick

How to use

  1. On clean, dry skin, swipe 2–3 times over rough areas.
  2. Leave on. Follow with moisturizer if you like.
  3. Start every other evening, then build to daily.
  4. Use sunscreen on treated areas during the day.

Good to know

Not for broken, irritated or freshly shaved skin. A light tingle is normal; stop if irritation occurs. Patch test first. For external use only.

Shipping

Free US shipping. Orders ship in 1–3 business days and arrive in 7–12 business days, with tracking.

30-day smooth-skin guarantee

Use it for 30 days. If you don't love how your skin feels, email us for a full refund. Keep the product.

During our launch, products ship in the manufacturer’s original packaging.
mittDesc:
Watch the dead skin roll away.

A Korean-style viscose exfoliating mitt for a deep, satisfying body buff in the shower. Pairs with The Smooth Stick for visibly smoother skin.

How to use

  1. Soak in warm water for 10 minutes so skin softens.
  2. Wet the mitt and rub in long strokes with light pressure.
  3. Rinse, then moisturize. Use 1–2 times a week.
  4. Rinse the mitt and hang to dry. Replace every 2–3 months.

Skip broken, sunburned or freshly shaved skin.

Shipping

Free US shipping. Orders ship in 1–3 business days and arrive in 7–12 business days, with tracking.

During our launch, products ship in the manufacturer’s original packaging.
heelDesc:
Soft heels, no greasy hands.

A twist-up balm with urea and salicylic acid that softens thick, rough, dry skin on heels and elbows. Swipe on at night and wake up to smoother, softer skin.

How to use

  1. Swipe onto clean, dry heels or elbows at night.
  2. Wear socks for best results.
  3. Use nightly until smooth, then 2–3 times a week.

For heels and elbows only. Not for face, legs or broken skin.
